translation: As a method, rubbing has benefit and no harm, and moreover it can block the source of disease and pull out the root of disease. In the way of thinking of harm and preventing it, nothing surpasses this. How could it be inferior to the medicine of digging a well when one is thirsty? Moreover, meeting a good physician is truly rare, and in distant villages and remote wilds there is even less of what is called medicine. How much more for consumption, fatigue, drum distension, and hiccups, where medical effect is hard to expect; above the diaphragm and below the fat, the power of medicine cannot reach. There are even those who lack the strength to summon a physician and buy medicine, who are especially to be pitied. The common saying goes, “If one has illness, rely on Heaven,” which is the speech of one who has no method and cannot do anything about it.
